fields.title: Place the Secrets
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Where it should live and why.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Payment provider key 2. Analytics application identifier 3. Webhook signing key 4. Database password 5. Public key for signature verification
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1, 3, 4 — server only, in secret storage. 2 — public identifier, can be in the client, grants no rights. 5 — public by design, can be anywhere. Takeaway: ask whether the string allows performing an action on behalf of the product; if yes — it's a secret.
